name: evidence-memory
description: Experimental current-session search and correction memory for external tool results (MCP and web by default) and your answers to Claude's questions; exact results stay local and may contain sensitive data.

python_executable.title: Python executable (optional)
python_executable.description: Leave empty for automatic Python 3.9+ discovery. Set an executable name or absolute path, without arguments, only to override discovery. No Git Bash required on Windows.
